subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: The FISA Court
description: A quick win: understand The FISA Court.

hook.text: A secret court approves nearly every government surveillance request it receives. Oversight in name only.

buildup.text: The Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Court reviews government requests to spy on suspected foreign agents.

discovery.text: Between 1979 and 2022, the FISA Court approved over 99.97% of all surveillance applications submitted.

twist.text: Only the government presents its case. There's no defense attorney, no public advocate, and no adversarial process.

climax.text: A court that approves almost everything and hears only one side isn't oversight — it's a rubber stamp.

punchline.text: 99.97% approved. One side heard. Secret court.

quiz.question: What percentage of surveillance applications did the FISA Court approve?
